hypothesis: Publishing atomic diagnostic counters on every accepted Melee specializer call costs measurable CPU and presentation throughput.
workload: Yoshi's Story, Ice Climbers vs Ice Climbers, ordinary two-controller native-frame input, 960x720 visible-image measurement
method: Same-checkpoint 30-second A/B/B/A comparison after one warm-up per measured leg; only leandispatch changed. In this build leandispatch suppresses specializer counter publications while leaving the specializers enabled.
interpretation: Accepted. Simulation deltas were noisy across the two pairs, but the symmetric mean was positive and both candidate legs improved paired visible delivery. This removes diagnostic-only atomic RMWs from production hot paths without changing emulation work or gameplay state.
